verdict.rationale: Airbyte documents a first-party Connector Builder: a no-code UI layered on its low-code YAML format that lets you build a custom connector inside the workspace without forking. It also covers incremental sync setup and an AI Assistant that prefills connector configuration. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of building long-tail API connectors, and evidence of a code-based connector framework for APIs too complex for the builder.
